Isolate external systems behind narrow brokers

Broker diagnostics keep infrastructure adapters atomic, interface-driven and free of business flow control. External SDKs, storage APIs and transport failures remain contained behind local contracts.

The value of enforcing this family

This reduces vendor coupling and gives services a stable boundary that can be substituted in tests or replaced as infrastructure changes.

Choose a diagnostic below for its Standard references, architectural rationale and practical bad and good code examples.
